title: Tilt-excess decay at all scales and convergence of planes (Simon 5.4.6 and proof of 5.5.2 (1)–(8))
statement: For n ≥ 1 and k ≥ 0 there are δ₂ ∈ (0, 1/8] and C > 0 such that for every δ ∈ (0, δ₂] and all data satisfying (SA_δ): U, W ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with W open and W ⊆ U; R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n; ξ_R = R.orient is its orientation, and ξ below denotes a point) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M; H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x; R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X with tsupport X ⊆ W; ρ > 0 with the closed ball B_ρ(z) ⊆ W; z ∈ spt μ; μ(B_ρ(z)) ≤ (1 + δ)ω_nρⁿ (ω_n = unitBallVolume n); κρ ≤ δ: for every ξ ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{δρ}(z), σ ∈ (0, δρ] and n-dimensional subspace T there is an n-dimensional subspace S with ∫_{B_s(ξ)} |p_x − p_S|² dμ ≤ C(s/σ)sⁿE_* for every s ∈ (0, σ] and |p_S − p_T|² ≤ C·E_*, where E_* := max{σ^{−n}∫_{B_σ(ξ)} |p_x − p_T|² dμ, κ²σ²/δ} ∈ [0, ∞]. Here p_x is the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x, p_x^⊥ := I − p_x, p_S the orthogonal projection onto a subspace S, |A|² := Σ_i |Ae_i|² the Hilbert–Schmidt norm (the Lean sum over EuclideanSpace.single i 1), B_t(y) the closed ball, and integrals of nonnegative functions are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞] (Lean ∫⁻ of ENNReal.ofReal).
